items.name: Portable camelCase/snake_case Fuzzy Normalization
items.counter_case: Normalized form loses word-boundary info; setUser and userSet both normalize similarly, risking false fuzzy matches.
items.gist: Min of raw vs. separator-stripped Levenshtein; prevents style-inflation bug in fuzzy identifier matching.

items.name: Generic Config File Node Indexing
items.counter_case: Creates noise nodes with no semantic content; blank config File nodes add query overhead without edges.

items.name: CGC_REPORT Generation Pattern
items.counter_case: Cortex graph is conceptual; god-node/cyclomatic-complexity metrics apply to structural CALLS graph, not synthesis entities.

items.name: O(k) Incremental Watcher Update
items.proposed_phase: Phase 1 Refinement — O(k) Incremental File Watcher
items.counter_case: Cortex's incremental work is LLM synthesis per entity, not CALLS edge re-linking; the O(k) optimization is less critical if there are no transitive link cascades.

items.name: Post-Resolution via Inheritance + Embeddings
items.counter_case: Requires structural CALLS graph from Phase 0.13 first; premature to implement before parsers produce CALLS edges.

items.name: Spring DI Semantic Edges
items.counter_case: Framework-specific edges lock schema to Spring vocabulary; would need equivalent rules for Django/Rails/Laravel — 5x scope expansion.

items.name: Job ETA Estimation + Idempotency Guard
items.counter_case: LLM synthesis latency is variable; file-count-based ETA may mislead when LLM is the bottleneck.

items.name: JVM/JS/C++ Language-Family Compatibility
items.counter_case: May overlap with Phase 0.3 Refinement Cross-Language Edge Gating from Graphify; risk of duplication.

items.name: Schema Contract as Frozen Set
items.counter_case: Cortex schema is fluid (entities evolve via LLM synthesis); freezing node labels in a constant precludes dynamic schema evolution.

items.name: 11-Tier Confidence Labels on CALLS Edges
items.counter_case: Requires Phase 0.13 structural CALLS graph to exist; confidence on edges is meaningless without edges.

items.name: Pre-scan Registry (Extension Dispatch)
items.counter_case: Registry pattern is more valuable at 10+ languages; simpler dispatch is fine until Phase 0.13 adds the parsers.
